label: А
description: Soft contrast and topic-shift sentences that use Russian 'a' naturally.

missions.phrase: я дома, а ты на работе
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Parallel contrast. 1. 'А' introduces a side-by-side comparison. 2. The two locations are clear and practical. 3. This is a very common spoken pattern.

missions.phrase: он пьет чай, а она кофе
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Light contrast. 1. 'А' links two different preferences. 2. The sentence is short and natural. 3. It is good for type-speed practice because the pattern is easy to repeat.

missions.phrase: мы идем пешком, а они едут
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion contrast. 1. The first clause uses walking. 2. The second clause uses vehicle motion. 3. 'А' keeps the contrast smooth rather than sharp.
Strategic focus: Corrective contrast. 1. 'Не дом' sets up a false guess. 2. 'А школа' corrects it. 3. This is a very important everyday Russian pattern.
Strategic focus: Split activity. 1. 'А' contrasts two simultaneous actions. 2. The two verbs match their subjects cleanly. 3. This sentence is simple but very useful.

missions.phrase: у меня есть вода, а у тебя нет
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Possession contrast. 1. 'У меня есть' is positive possession. 2. 'У тебя нет' is the negative mirror. 3. The sentence is excellent for case practice and everyday meaning.
Strategic focus: Opposed states. 1. Two short-form adjectives make the contrast crisp. 2. 'Открыта' and 'закрыто' are easy to compare. 3. This is a strong visual training sentence.

missions.phrase: сегодня холодно, а вчера было тепло
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Time-based contrast. 1. 'Сегодня' and 'вчера' anchor the comparison. 2. 'Было тепло' gives a past-state frame. 3. This sentence is useful for weather talk.
Strategic focus: Family comparison. 1. 'Старший' and 'младший' are common comparative labels. 2. 'А' links them as a natural pair. 3. The sentence is short and highly reusable.
Strategic focus: Environmental contrast. 1. 'Здесь' and 'там' give a clear spatial split. 2. 'Тихо' and 'шумно' are a useful adjective pair. 3. The line is ideal for rhythm and comparison practice.
